description: This file exports types, functions, and constants related to the ACPX runtime backend helpers, plugin API schemas, Windows spawn utilities, and environment variable helpers used within the project.

methods.name: registerAcpRuntimeBackend
methods.description: Registers an ACP runtime backend implementation.

methods.name: unregisterAcpRuntimeBackend
methods.description: Unregisters an ACP runtime backend implementation.

methods.name: applyWindowsSpawnProgramPolicy
methods.description: Applies policy settings to a Windows spawn program.

methods.name: materializeWindowsSpawnProgram
methods.description: Creates or configures a Windows spawn program based on provided inputs.

methods.name: resolveWindowsSpawnProgramCandidate
methods.description: Resolves a candidate configuration into a spawn program.

methods.name: listKnownProviderAuthEnvVarNames
methods.description: Lists environment variable names known for provider authentication.

methods.name: omitEnvKeysCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Removes environment variables keys in a case-insensitive manner.
